supportedClaims: N=71 is the most induction-sensitive regime.
K boost is a threshold artifact — 0% persistence after continuation.
Full K graft creates immediate induction at N=71 (41%).
No strict persistent Lo→Hi conversion demonstrated.
V5.9 directional commitment survives all validated V5.10 tests.
Strict persistence (immediate high + survives +1 epoch) is the required evidence for genuine induction.
conditionalClaims: N=71 is the strongest induction window — results at other N are weaker.
K-graft immediate induction is strongest at CP4, weaker at earlier checkpoints.
Full K graft outperforms K_mean-only and K_std-only for immediate induction.
Control asymmetry may be basin-structural (Hi→Lo down-gradient, Lo→Hi barrier).
